title: Design System: Костя Тракторёнок — Monitoring Console Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero H1 only; tight tracking, balanced wrap, ~17ch cap.

headline.purpose: Section titles and the contact card headline.

label.purpose: Geist Mono for all data, labels, metrics, endpoints, stack tags, timestamps; often uppercase, tracking 0.08em.

shadows.name: edge-top
shadows.purpose: Default lift for dark panels, cards, chips, ghost buttons — a hairline of light along the top edge (Better Stack signature).

shadows.name: shadow-raise
shadows.purpose: Ambient underline added with edge-top on larger structural panels.

shadows.name: shadow-btn
shadows.purpose: White primary pill's bright inset top-line plus soft drop; makes the CTA read as a physical key.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for section fade-up, button lift, scan sweep, and dot settling.

motion.name: sweep
motion.purpose: Monitor 'come online' left-to-right green scan sweep; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: pulse-ring
motion.purpose: Expanding halo on live-status dots; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: IntersectionObserver scroll fade-up; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

narrative.overview: The portfolio is built as a piece of the candidate's own developer tooling: a monochrome, near-black observability console in the Better Stack idiom. The ground is almost pure black (#08080a), structure is drawn with hairline borders rather than fills, and the entire surface reads as an operations dashboard where every panel is a status readout. The one idea it owns: deployed projects are rendered as live monitors — each one operational, linkable, and observable right now. Density is high and composed: content-height sections, hairline-ruled rows, and data expressed in monospace give the feel of a working instrument rather than a marketing page. Colour is withheld almost entirely — a single operational-green signal (#3ecf8e) carries availability and live status and nothing else. Depth is quiet: a faint overhead radial light and a signature inset top-highlight on raised surfaces, never heavy drop shadows as decoration. This world explicitly refuses the prior editorial stack-of-sheets treatment and the generic neon-glow dark hero.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome near-black ground built from layered neutral panels, not flat black.
Hairline borders as the primary structural device; fills are secondary.
Exactly one signal colour — operational green — reserved for live/available state.
Geist for everything; Geist Mono for all data, labels, metadata, and metrics.
Signature live-monitor 'come online' scan sweep, fully disabled under reduced motion.
WCAG 2.2 AA, themed browser surfaces, and reduced-motion support are part of the system.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Operational green appears only where it reports real operational truth — live status, availability, the active phase. If green would be decoration, it is wrong. Everything expressive is carried by neutrals and the white action instead.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Data Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is reserved for machine-readable content — labels, metrics, endpoints, timestamps, stack tags, status text. If text is prose a human reads in sentences, it is Geist Sans. The mono/sans split is how the console signals 'this is a readout'.

rules.name: The Edge-Not-Drop Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are lifted by a top edge-highlight and a hairline border first; ambient drop shadow is added only on the few large structural panels. Shadow is never used as decoration or hover flourish — hover shifts border and background, not elevation.

dos: Do build structure from hairline borders (#26262c standard, #1b1b20 internal rules, #35353d hover/emphasis) before reaching for fills.
Do layer surfaces on the panel ramp (#121216 → #17171c → #1d1d23) and lift them with the Edge Top inset highlight.
Do set every label, metric, endpoint, timestamp, and stack tag in Geist Mono; keep prose in Geist Sans (the Mono-Means-Data Rule).
Do reserve operational green (#3ecf8e) for live/available state only (the One Signal Rule), and keep the white pill the single primary action.

Do disable the monitor sweep and dot pulse under prefers-reduced-motion, rendering status dots steady green, and keep focus-visible (2px green outline), selection, caret, and scrollbar themed from the palette.
donts: Don't use green for decoration, borders, headings, or hover states — if it isn't reporting operational truth, it's wrong.
Don't add drop shadows as decoration or hover flourish; hover shifts border and background, not elevation (the Edge-Not-Drop Rule).
Don't introduce a second accent hue, gradient fill, or neon glow — the world is monochrome plus one signal.
Don't force sections to 100vh; size them to content on the 1080px column.
